ITEM 1 | Thinly sliced round discs with pale green-white rim and magenta-pink center and radial streaks, about 4 cm across, several pieces scattered on the upper-center and left of the salad, slightly glossy, firm-looking, no cooking marks | 25
ITEM 2 | Shredded pale cream-white strands, fine julienne about 5-6 cm long, slightly glossy and moist, forming a loose tangle across the center of the plate, no browning | 40
ITEM 3 | Thin julienned orange-red carrot matchsticks about 4-5 cm long, bright orange, crisp-looking, scattered throughout the pale shreds in the center | 8
ITEM 4 | Mixed leafy greens including pale green crinkled leaves and darker green flat leaves, some with light green sheen, clustered at the lower-right and left edges, moist, with a few thin green stalks about 5-6 cm long | 30
ITEM 5 | Thin green slivers and small diced bits, pale green and bright green, about 0.5 cm pieces, sparse, scattered near the top-center of the salad | 3
ITEM 6 | Dark purple-red shredded cabbage-like strands, thin, about 3-4 cm long, sparse, mostly at lower-center and edges of the salad | 5
ITEM 7 | Thin clear to light yellow dressing sheen coating the greens and shreds, glossy film with no pooled liquid visible, lightly wetting the leaves | 6
